entry.name: Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
entry.note: Retired by Microsoft. The certification page states that this certification and its renewal assessment are retired
entry.audience: Engineers building on Azure AI services

reading.summary: This certification validates the ability to design and implement Azure AI solutions using Azure AI services, Azure AI Search, and Azure Open AI. Holding it shows skill in using REST APIs and SDKs to build secure image processing, video processing, natural language processing, knowledge mining, and generative AI solutions on Azure.

same_level.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
same_level.note: Retired by AWS. The last day to take the exam was March 31, 2026; AWS states that holders keep an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned. AWS now points candidates to the Machine Learning Engineer Associate

same_provider.name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (exam AI-901)
same_provider.note: Foundational Microsoft credential. The required exam is now AI-901, and Microsoft states the English version was updated on April 15, 2026 and expects knowledge of Python syntax
